reason: Skill-surface integrity checks for #487 (#452 stays open): module-size 29124->30023 (+899). Measured empirically on both sides rather than read off the printed arrow, which is misleading here in the way #689 warns about: the verdict line reads 26965 -> 30023 (+3058), but baselines.json is stale and 2159 of that is main's own already-allowed growth. main's true absolute was obtained by moving .harness/arch/allowances/ aside so the base tree reports its own currentValue, which came back 29124. The +899 is fully attributable to three files and nothing else in the diff: ts/src/core/skill-surfaces.ts (391 lines), ts/src/core/skill-examples.ts (395), and +172 net in ts/src/skills-cli.ts for the `skills verify` subcommand -- 958 raw lines, which module-size scores as 899. The two new test suites (ts/test/skill-surfaces.test.ts, ts/test/skill-examples.test.ts) are test code and module-size does not count them, and the remainder of the change is CHANGELOG.md, .github/workflows/dogfood.yml, .github/required-checks.json, and two rows in ts/test/gate-conformance.test.ts. What the 899 buys: nothing in this repository has ever verified that a skill's DECLARED surface matches reality. A skill name is declared in up to six places (agents/skills/<host>/<dir>/SKILL.md, the flat agents/skills/*.md, commands/*.md, agents/*.md, agents/commands/<host>/, agents/agents/<host>/), each internally consistent, so every per-file assertion passes even when they disagree with each other or point at something deleted -- the shape of #465, #455 and #472. skill-surfaces.ts builds the cross-surface inventory and grades declarations against resolvability (frontmatter name vs directory, a cli: target missing or at mode 0644 per #478, a documented `canary skills run <name>` reaching no discoverable skill); skill-examples.ts EXECUTES the commands the docs promise, which is #487, replacing the per-skill spawnSync block #480 copied verbatim across five test files (#479) with a discovery-driven runner that picks up a new skill automatically. A large share of both files is comment, deliberately and for the same reason the doc-link checker's is: the load-bearing decisions are the ones a later reader would otherwise undo -- why prose divergence is NOT adjudicated (#452's triage settled that with no fixture-intent floor there is no principled culprit, so reporting a majority winner would be wrong at N=2), why an unverifiable example is recorded with its reason instead of dropped (the D7 skip channel, so an all-illustrative corpus abstains rather than reporting 'all 0 examples passed'), and why --allow-executable-skills must be inserted BEFORE the `--` separator (appending it made all four documented `skills run ... -- --help` examples report exit 3, i.e. the checker measuring its own sandbox rather than the docs). Nothing was absorbed here to avoid a fix: newViolations is 0 and the pre-existing violations stay at 21. Two complexity findings the first run DID raise against this code were fixed rather than allowed -- verifyCmd was split into exampleHalf/verifyJson/verifyReport/tallyByKind (cyclomaticComplexity 17->under threshold, functionLength 90->under 50) and the fence loop's closing test was extracted as closesFence (11->under 10). Splitting the two core modules further would not help: module-size is a repo-wide aggregate, so N files summing to 899 score identically to two, and both files sit well under the per-file thresholds. Earning its keep on arrival: the first sweep reports 80 surface declarations with 0 consistency findings, and on the examples half 4 executed clean, 29 unverifiable, and 1 finding -- canary-shadow declares a cli: and documents no runnable command, which is precisely the skill #487 named as its live example. Verified against a known break as #487's acceptance requires: reverting canary-blackhawk's exec bit is caught by both halves, the execution half reproducing #472's exact symptom (exit 1, no output). REBASED 2026-08-13 onto 968fc65: this branch was originally cut from 294ce9f, where main measured 28634 and this file recorded an absolute of 29533. Two changes then landed -- #702 () and the #709 entropy paydown -- moving main to 29124. This change's own contribution is UNCHANGED at +899; only the base beneath it moved, which is the known hazard of absolute-valued allowances (#689) and the reason both sides were re-measured from scratch rather than the delta being carried across arithmetically. Both absolutes were obtained the same way on the same tree: move .harness/arch/allowances/ aside so the measured side reports its own currentValue.
